strategy_version: BTC+ETH Macro Hedge V3.6 - V3.1 + Isolated Anti-Whipsaw Lite

models.H0: Initial allocation only; no DCA; no tactical trading

anti_whipsaw.accumulation_episode_start: first BEAR or DEEP_BEAR to ACCUMULATION transition
anti_whipsaw.accumulation_episode_end: NEW_BULL confirmation or formal macro-cycle completion
anti_whipsaw.same_timestamp_priority: risk sell wins; tactical buy is suppressed
anti_whipsaw.duplicate_scope: signal_type plus accumulation_episode_id until the explicitly defined value rearm

operational_interpretations.baseline_execution_order: Model B uses the untouched V3.1 engine so replay identity is testable
operational_interpretations.challenger_execution_order: Model H executes fixed DCA first, then completed-daily-signal risk/FSM logic
operational_interpretations.new_20d_low_definition: completed BTC close <= minimum of the preceding 20 completed BTC closes
operational_interpretations.rearm_definition: base buy used; active target <=25%; >=7 calendar days since latest tactical sell while episode active; no new 20-day close low in the latest 3 completed closes; original AHR condition is true
operational_interpretations.deep_value_note: V3.1 has no separate deep-value tactical action; the reserved signal type is audited as not applicable and no new buy rule is invented
operational_interpretations.right_side_source_targets: RIGHT_SIDE_TO50 is only 35->50 and RIGHT_SIDE_TO60 is only 50->60
operational_interpretations.sell_timestamp_tracking: any executed tactical SELL while an accumulation episode is active starts the 7-day rebuy cooldown
operational_interpretations.crash_collision: an actually eligible V3.1 Crash L1/L2 sell vetoes a same-timestamp accumulation buy; crash execution remains the original V3.1 rule
